Record Class MultiblockStructure

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
fr.robie.machineengine.api.multiblock.MultiblockStructure
Record Components:
min - the lowest corner of its bounding box (walls included)
max - the highest corner of its bounding box
members - the blocks that make it, for a MultiblockShape.Pattern; null for a box, which is made of its whole bounding box
rotation - quarter turns clockwise (seen from above) a pattern was matched with; 0 for a box
counts - for a box, what its interior holds, by block id; for a pattern, its blocks, by block id
anchor - the block holding its storages: a box's lowest corner, a pattern's anchor character
public record MultiblockStructure(@NotNull MultiblockType type, @NotNull net.kyori.adventure.key.Key world, @NotNull BlockPosition min, @NotNull BlockPosition max, @NotNull BlockPosition anchorPosition, @Nullable Set<BlockPosition> members, int rotation, @NotNull Map<net.kyori.adventure.key.Key, Integer> counts) extends Record
A formed multiblock (D33).
